description: A set of components to display files and data in various formats
oomol-preview-oomol: OOMOL Preview is a package that provides ready-to-use building blocks (components) for the OOMOL platform, designed to preview different types of content. Whether you are working with images, videos, audio files, documents, or data files, this package can meet your needs.
display-and-preview-audio-files-in-vario: Display and preview audio files in various formats including MP3, MP4, WAV, WebM, FLAC, Opus, PCM, Vorbis, and AAC
path-to-the-audio-file-to-preview: Path to the audio file to preview
display-and-preview-image-from-binary-da: Display and preview image from binary data stream
binary-data-of-the-image-to-preview: Binary data of the image to preview
display-and-preview-image-files-in-vario: Display and preview image files in various formats including PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, BMP, ICO, and TIFF
path-to-the-image-file-to-preview: Path to the image file to preview
display-and-preview-multiple-image-files: Display and preview multiple image files in a gallery view
array-of-image-file-paths-to-preview: Array of image file paths to preview
display-and-preview-json-file-content-wi: Display and preview JSON file content with syntax highlighting
path-to-the-json-file-to-preview: Path to the JSON file to preview
display-and-preview-json-string-content-: Display and preview JSON string content with syntax highlighting
path-to-the-markdown-file-to-preview: Path to the Markdown file to preview
